dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はい、じゃあ今日はここまで。特に言うこと
　はない。以上」
dialogues.en: "Alright, that concludes today's lessons."
dialogues.text: "Alright, that concludes today's lessons."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の号令と共に、一斉に学生が帰り支度を
始める。
dialogues.en:
The throngs of students started packing up to go home, at
Koyomi-sensei's signal.
dialogues.text:
The throngs of students started packing up to go home, at
Koyomi-sensei's signal.

dialogues.jp: よっしゃ、今日も終わった。
dialogues.en: That's it for school for today.
dialogues.text: That's it for school for today.

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きく伸びをする。
dialogues.en: I took a nice, long stretch.
dialogues.text: I took a nice, long stretch.

dialogues.jp: さて、環の様子でも見に行くか。
dialogues.en: I'll go check on how Tamaki's doing.
dialogues.text: I'll go check on how Tamaki's doing.

dialogues.jp:
新しく入った二人も、ちょっとずつ打ち解けて
るみたいだし……。
dialogues.en: Those two new girls didn't seem very comfortable...
dialogues.text: Those two new girls didn't seem very comfortable...

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「すごいよな、野球部」
dialogues.en: "The baseball club's amazing!"
dialogues.text: "The baseball club's amazing!"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 2
dialogues.jp: 「二回戦も勝ったらしいぞ。ありえないよな」
dialogues.en:
"I couldn't believe my ears when I heard they won two
matches in a row."
dialogues.text:
"I couldn't believe my ears when I heard they won two
matches in a row."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp:
「なんでも、巫女部のお陰だって触れ回ってる
　けど」
dialogues.en:
"I heard the Miko Club had something to do with their
prowess."
dialogues.text:
"I heard the Miko Club had something to do with their
prowess."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「俺も知ってる。必勝祈願だろ？　利くらしい
　よな」
dialogues.en:
"I've heard of that too. A victory prayer, wasn't it? It
sure seems to have worked."
dialogues.text:
"I've heard of that too. A victory prayer, wasn't it? It
sure seems to have worked."

dialogues.jp: ふと気がつくと。
dialogues.en: The words fell sharply into my ears.
dialogues.text: The words fell sharply into my ears.

dialogues.jp: 環は噂の人になっている。
dialogues.en: People gossiping about Tamaki...
dialogues.text: People gossiping about Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、野球部が一回戦のみならず、二回戦
を突破したからだからだが……。
dialogues.en:
Of course, for the baseball club to win not once, but
twice...
dialogues.text:
Of course, for the baseball club to win not once, but
twice...

dialogues.jp:
あいつらじゃ無理だと思ってたけど、結構やる
もんだ。
dialogues.en:
Everyone thought they were useless, but now they're actually
making a name for themselves.
dialogues.text:
Everyone thought they were useless, but now they're actually
making a name for themselves.

dialogues.jp: それとも、本当に環の力のお陰なのだろうか。
dialogues.en: How much of that was really down to Tamaki, I wonder.
dialogues.text: How much of that was really down to Tamaki, I wonder.

dialogues.jp:
ま、噂されるにしても、以前のような中傷じゃ
ないからな。
dialogues.en: Well, as long as it's not ill-intentioned.
dialogues.text: Well, as long as it's not ill-intentioned.

dialogues.jp: まだ良しとするべきか……。
dialogues.en: Yet, I wonder...
dialogues.text: Yet, I wonder...

dialogues.jp: この噂の中で……。
dialogues.en: Within all this gossiping by people..
dialogues.text: Within all this gossiping by people..

dialogues.jp:
環のことを本当に見ている人間は、何人いるん
だろう？
dialogues.en:
How many of them are actually able to see Tamaki for the
kind of person she is?
dialogues.text:
How many of them are actually able to see Tamaki for the
kind of person she is?

dialogues.jp:
環の優しさや、可愛らしさや、強さや、弱さを
きちんと、見てる人はいるんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Her kindness, her cuteness, her strengths and weaknesses,
are there anybody who's actually interested in that?
dialogues.text:
Her kindness, her cuteness, her strengths and weaknesses,
are there anybody who's actually interested in that?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さすがだな。胡ノ宮嬢は」
dialogues.en: "That Konomiya's really something."
dialogues.text: "That Konomiya's really something."

dialogues.jp: 杉並は俺の肩に手を置いて話しかけてくる。
dialogues.en: Suginami patted me on the shoulder as he spoke.
dialogues.text: Suginami patted me on the shoulder as he spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺も一つ、見てもらいたいものが……」
dialogues.en: "I want her to look for something for me..."
dialogues.text: "I want her to look for something for me..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What."
dialogues.text: "What."

dialogues.jp:
どうせ杉並のことだから、ろくな物じゃない気
がするが……。
dialogues.en: Knowing him, it'd be something completely stupid.
dialogues.text: Knowing him, it'd be something completely stupid.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「江戸幕府が隠したと言われる地図が、杉並家
　代々の家宝として伝わっているのだ」
dialogues.en:
"There was a map that was handed down the Suginamis from
generation to generation, but lost to the sands of time..."
dialogues.text:
"There was a map that was handed down the Suginamis from
generation to generation, but lost to the sands of time..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ぜひ今度、その地図を見て欲しいと思ってな」
dialogues.en: "I'd ask her to help me see it next time."
dialogues.text: "I'd ask her to help me see it next time."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「杉並、お前まで……」
dialogues.en: "Suginami, you..."
dialogues.text: "Suginami, you..."

dialogues.jp: 俺はため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I lost my words, and just let out a heavy sigh.
dialogues.text: I lost my words, and just let out a heavy sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、埋蔵金がな……」
dialogues.en: "It must've been a treasure map, so..."
dialogues.text: "It must've been a treasure map, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、環を何だと思ってるんだ」
dialogues.en: "What the hell do you think Tamaki is?"
dialogues.text: "What the hell do you think Tamaki is?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、黄金が……」
dialogues.en: "But... it's treasure...!"
dialogues.text: "But... it's treasure...!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、まだ何かのたまう杉並を無視し、鞄に教
科書を詰める。
dialogues.en: I started to pack my bag, deciding that ignorance is bliss.
dialogues.text: I started to pack my bag, deciding that ignorance is bliss.

dialogues.jp: まったく。
dialogues.en: Sigh.
dialogues.text: Sigh.

dialogues.jp:
環を、ただの都合のいい道具として見ているや
つらが多い気がする。
dialogues.en:
There's so many people who see Tamaki as little more than a
useful tool.
dialogues.text:
There's so many people who see Tamaki as little more than a
useful tool.

dialogues.jp:
みんなを敵に回しても、俺だけは、ずっと環を
見守っていよう。
dialogues.en:
Even if it makes me everyone's enemy, I'd protect her from
them.
dialogues.text:
Even if it makes me everyone's enemy, I'd protect her from
them.

dialogues.jp: 心から、そう思う。
dialogues.en: I made that a vow, in my heart.
dialogues.text: I made that a vow, in my heart.

dialogues.jp: 環の様子を見に、巫女同好会の部室へ行く。
dialogues.en:
The Miko Appreciation Club was my destination, to check up
on Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
The Miko Appreciation Club was my destination, to check up
on Tamaki.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp: と、部室のドアを開けると、
dialogues.en: I said as I opened the clubroom door.
dialogues.text: I said as I opened the clubroom door.

dialogues.jp:
中には環のほかに、５人の巫女装束の女の子が
いた。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't just Tamaki inside, but 5 other girls clad in Miko
costumes as well.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't just Tamaki inside, but 5 other girls clad in Miko
costumes as well.

dialogues.jp: うわっ。
dialogues.en: Wow...
dialogues.text: Wow...

dialogues.jp: な、何か増えてる。
dialogues.en: They sure pop out fast.
dialogues.text: They sure pop out fast.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい、じゃあみんなで一緒に。せーの！」
dialogues.en: "Alright, now, everyone at once!"
dialogues.text: "Alright, now, everyone at once!"

dialogues.jp:
環が掛け声をかけると、５人の巫女達は一斉に
払い棒を振り下ろす。
dialogues.en:
At the sound of her voice, all 5 of the Miko swung their
kendo pole downwards.
dialogues.text:
At the sound of her voice, all 5 of the Miko swung their
kendo pole downwards.

dialogues.jp: 誰も、俺に気がつく気配はない。
dialogues.en: None of them seem to have noticed me.
dialogues.text: None of them seem to have noticed me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Okay, once again. 1, 2, 1, 2."
dialogues.text: "Okay, once again. 1, 2, 1, 2."

dialogues.jp:
払い棒が上がったり下がったりするのを見なが
ら、俺は何となく幸せな気分になる。
dialogues.en:
Seeing those kendo poles swung up and down brought a feeling
of happiness to me.
dialogues.text:
Seeing those kendo poles swung up and down brought a feeling
of happiness to me.

dialogues.jp: 何か、巫女を肌で感じてるって感じ……。
dialogues.en: All the Miko with their pure white legs...
dialogues.text: All the Miko with their pure white legs...

dialogues.jp:
俺は幸せを感じつつも、声を掛けるのを思い留
まる。
dialogues.en: I was unable to do anything but stand and stare slackjawed.
dialogues.text: I was unable to do anything but stand and stare slackjawed.

dialogues.jp: 見ている分にはいいが、邪魔はできない。
dialogues.en:
I didn't want to be a bother, but I didn't want to stop
watching either.
dialogues.text:
I didn't want to be a bother, but I didn't want to stop
watching either.

dialogues.jp: まずいところに来たな……。
dialogues.en: This is a bit of a problem...
dialogues.text: This is a bit of a problem...

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず苦笑いをする。
dialogues.en:
I smiled wryly to myself, tasting heaven and possibly
tasting hell.
dialogues.text:
I smiled wryly to myself, tasting heaven and possibly
tasting hell.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら。朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺に気づき、微笑みかける。
dialogues.en: Tamaki eventually noticed me, and smiled.
dialogues.text: Tamaki eventually noticed me, and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ちょうど今、お｛はら／祓｝いの説明をしていたんです
　よ」
dialogues.en: "I am giving them an explanation on purification."
dialogues.text: "I am giving them an explanation on purification."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ah, I see..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I see..."

dialogues.jp:
しかし、今日はここで見てるわけにもいかない
よな。
dialogues.en: I really should stop interefering in that case.
dialogues.text: I really should stop interefering in that case.

dialogues.jp: 気持ちとしては、もっと見ていたいが。
dialogues.en: Although deep down, I wanted to keep watching...
dialogues.text: Although deep down, I wanted to keep watching...

dialogues.jp: 人口密度も、少し高い。
dialogues.en:
The population here was a bit too much to include me as
well.
dialogues.text:
The population here was a bit too much to include me as
well.

dialogues.jp:
部員が三人だったらいざ知らず、増えてくると、
部外者がいるわけにもいかないだろう。
dialogues.en:
I knew there were three members, but it seems that some
people joined, or people outside the club were interested.
dialogues.text:
I knew there were three members, but it seems that some
people joined, or people outside the club were interested.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、俺、用事あるから、外で時間を潰すわ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I have things to do, I better hurry off."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I have things to do, I better hurry off."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「すみません。では、また」
dialogues.en: "Alright. I shall see you later."
dialogues.text: "Alright. I shall see you later."

dialogues.jp: 俺は部室を出て、ドアを閉める。
dialogues.en: I exited the room, closing the door behind me.
dialogues.text: I exited the room, closing the door behind me.

dialogues.jp:
あんな、女の子ばかりのところに、いるわけに
もいかない。
dialogues.en: With so many women there, I felt out of place.
dialogues.text: With so many women there, I felt out of place.

dialogues.jp: 気まずい。
dialogues.en: My testosterone was in danger...
dialogues.text: My testosterone was in danger...

dialogues.jp: さて、どうすっかな……。
dialogues.en: Now, what to do...
dialogues.text: Now, what to do...

dialogues.jp: 俺は中庭の方へと歩いていった。
dialogues.en: While thinking, my feet led me to the courtyard.
dialogues.text: While thinking, my feet led me to the courtyard.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp: 中庭のベンチには、ことりが座っていた。
dialogues.en: Kotori was there, sitting on one of the benches.
dialogues.text: Kotori was there, sitting on one of the benches.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.jp:
そこには、ベンチに座って、文庫本を読んでい
ることりの姿があった。
dialogues.en: She seemed to have been engrossed in her library book.
dialogues.text: She seemed to have been engrossed in her library book.

dialogues.jp: 「午後の読書ってヤツか」
dialogues.en: "You're a real bookworm, even reading after school, huh?"
dialogues.text: "You're a real bookworm, even reading after school, huh?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、『ええ』とにこやかに返事をし、ぱ
たんと本を閉じた。
dialogues.en: Kotori quickly shut her book tight, slightly embarassed.
dialogues.text: Kotori quickly shut her book tight, slightly embarassed.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君は？」
dialogues.en: "What's up, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "What's up, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺？　環を待ってるんだ」
dialogues.en: "Me? I'm just waiting for Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Me? I'm just waiting for Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「巫女部が終わったら一緒に帰ろうと思ってさ」
dialogues.en:
"I figured we'd go home together after her Miko Club ends
for the day."
dialogues.text:
"I figured we'd go home together after her Miko Club ends
for the day."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん。仲いいんだね」
dialogues.en: "Heeh, you've been really close, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Heeh, you've been really close, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それほどでもないけどな」
dialogues.en: "I, it's not what you're thinking..."
dialogues.text: "I, it's not what you're thinking..."

dialogues.jp: ことりの言葉に、思わず赤面する。
dialogues.en: Her playfulness was starting to make me blush.
dialogues.text: Her playfulness was starting to make me blush.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「付き合ってるの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you dating?"
dialogues.text: "Are you dating?"

dialogues.jp: ことりは、いきなり核心をついてくる。
dialogues.en: Dating...
dialogues.text: Dating...

dialogues.jp: 付き合う……。
dialogues.en: ...I wonder what we really are doing.
dialogues.text: ...I wonder what we really are doing.

dialogues.jp: って、本当はどういうことなんだろう。
dialogues.en: We go home together and try to do things together often.
dialogues.text: We go home together and try to do things together often.

dialogues.jp:
一緒に帰ったり、遊びに行ったりするだけで付
き合ってるというなら、それはそうだ。
dialogues.en:
We've even done... things... and there's definitely a deep
closeness between us.
dialogues.text:
We've even done... things... and there's definitely a deep
closeness between us.

dialogues.jp:
でも、付き合うってことは、もっと他に何か必
要なんじゃないだろうか？
dialogues.en:
But... isn't there something else needed for us to be
considered together?
dialogues.text:
But... isn't there something else needed for us to be
considered together?

dialogues.jp:
そうは思いながらも、環と俺が付き合ってない
のか、と言うと、それは違う。
dialogues.en:
But even though that may be true... it'd be more correct to
say we are, than to say we aren't.
dialogues.text:
But even though that may be true... it'd be more correct to
say we are, than to say we aren't.

dialogues.jp: 特別な存在には間違いないのだから。
dialogues.en: We're definitely special in each other's lives.
dialogues.text: We're definitely special in each other's lives.

dialogues.jp: 「え、うん……。そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Erm... yeah."
dialogues.text: "Erm... yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ことりの問いかけを肯定する。
dialogues.en:
After a lot of thought, I answered her inquiry
affirmatively.
dialogues.text:
After a lot of thought, I answered her inquiry
affirmatively.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "I seeee."
dialogues.text: "I seeee."

dialogues.jp: ことりは意味深な笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
Kotori smiled, one that seemed to have a deep meaning behind
it.
dialogues.text:
Kotori smiled, one that seemed to have a deep meaning behind
it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「胡ノ宮さん、魅力的だもんね」
dialogues.en: "Konomiya-san is really charming."
dialogues.text: "Konomiya-san is really charming."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、なあ……」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は照れ笑いで誤魔化す。
dialogues.en: I laughed nervously.
dialogues.text: I laughed nervously.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、淋しい面も持ってるんだろうな」
dialogues.en: "But I'm sure she has a lonely side too."
dialogues.text: "But I'm sure she has a lonely side too."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: ことりの言葉に、思わずドキっとする。
dialogues.en: Kotori's words made my heart skip a bit.
dialogues.text: Kotori's words made my heart skip a bit.

dialogues.jp: ことりはニッコリと俺に笑いかける。
dialogues.en:
Her own smile showed she was completely unaware of my
palpitations.
dialogues.text:
Her own smile showed she was completely unaware of my
palpitations.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、不思議な力のある人って、時々人間が
　信じられなくなるって言うじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"I mean, with the power she has, it's hard for her to trust
people, I'm sure."
dialogues.text:
"I mean, with the power she has, it's hard for her to trust
people, I'm sure."

dialogues.jp: そんなもんなのかね……。
dialogues.en: That is quite true...
dialogues.text: That is quite true...

dialogues.jp:
確かに、これまで本当の環を見てくれる人は、
いなかったみたいだが……。
dialogues.en:
It doesn't seem like anyone's able to see Tamaki for who she
really is.
dialogues.text:
It doesn't seem like anyone's able to see Tamaki for who she
really is.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君が、しっかり支えてあげないとね」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, you have to be good and strong for her."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, you have to be good and strong for her."

dialogues.jp: と、ことりは俺の肩をポンっと叩く。
dialogues.en: She said, as she patted my shoulder.
dialogues.text: She said, as she patted my shoulder.

dialogues.en: "A, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh..."

dialogues.jp: なんだか……。
dialogues.en: Man...
dialogues.text: Man...

dialogues.jp: ことりに見透かされているような気がして。
dialogues.en: She read us as if we were a pair of open books.
dialogues.text: She read us as if we were a pair of open books.

dialogues.jp: まるで環のことが分かるみたいだ。
dialogues.en: And she seemed to know about Tamaki's power too.
dialogues.text: And she seemed to know about Tamaki's power too.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、ふふ、と笑うと、また本を開いて続
きを読み始めた。
dialogues.en: With a giggle, Kotori went back to the book she was reading.
dialogues.text: With a giggle, Kotori went back to the book she was reading.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、
dialogues.en: Maybe,
dialogues.text: Maybe,

dialogues.jp: 環のこと、実は分かってあげてないのかな……。
dialogues.en:
Just maybe, I don't know as much about Tamaki as I thought I
did...
dialogues.text:
Just maybe, I don't know as much about Tamaki as I thought I
did...

dialogues.jp: ◆環との関係◆
dialogues.en: ◆Relationship With Tamaki?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Relationship With Tamaki?◆

dialogues.jp:
巫女同好会へ見学に行くと、部員が５人に増え
ている。
dialogues.en:
When I went to check up on the Miko Appreciation Club, it
had already grown to 5 members strong.
dialogues.text:
When I went to check up on the Miko Appreciation Club, it
had already grown to 5 members strong.

dialogues.jp:
仕方がなく、時間を潰そうとしていると、中庭
でことりに出会う。
dialogues.en:
Deciding it was not the place for me, I killed time by going
to the courtyard, and meeting Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Deciding it was not the place for me, I killed time by going
to the courtyard, and meeting Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
ことりに環との関係を聞かれ、付き合っている
ことを告白する。
dialogues.en:
Kotori wanted to know the relationship between Tamaki and I,
and I confessed we were Ndating.
dialogues.text:
Kotori wanted to know the relationship between Tamaki and I,
and I confessed we were Ndating.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは言う。環はきっと心に淋しい面を持っ
ている。
dialogues.en: She said that Tamaki's heart must definitely be lonely.
